exposure: Intensity of perinatal care for extremely preterm babies
Level of perinatal care intensity (low, medium, high) based on the ratio of 24-25 week GA babies admitted to NICU to fetuses of the same GA alive at maternal admission
outcome: Ages and Stages Questionnaire (ASQ) score below threshold
cohort: Fetuses from the 2011 French national prospective EPIPAGE-2 cohort, alive at maternal admission to a level 3 hospital and delivered at 27-28 weeks' GA
finding: There was no difference in survival or morbidity-free survival at two years of age among fetuses alive at maternal hospital admission born at 27-28 weeks' GA, or in sensorimotor disability or presence of an ASQ below threshold among survivors.
